paragraphs.text: Leovold of Trest is an elven ambassador of the city state of Trest on the plane of Fiora .

Leovold's latest posting is the High City of Paliano . He has been making his presence known in the city by hosting elaborate parties, banquets, and other displays with the express intent of "cultural exchange." He is known for his grand gestures and bold proclamations of friendship, but he secretly gathers intelligence on all notable citizens. He will exchange what he has collected with the right people for the right price.
